text.Warning Beacon:
How to Play ==
When you play Warning Beacon is put an Outpost with 2 defense in play and you gain 2 Combat. When you acquire this card, if you've played a Machine Cult card this turn, you may put this card directly into your hand.
 Strategy ==
Warning Beacon can be within certain condition a very helpful card. Maybe you need it to achieve a goal. The card self ain't that powerful and a shield of 2 very meager.
